Is this approach worth a try?

messages.subject: Re: CamtrapR for Survival Analysis in RMark
parts:
Dear Juergen,

Yes it is the same as data(robust).  The problems with generating encounter histories for each primary occasions separately is that each primary occasion has a set of individuals which is not completely identical with others. I personally found it easier to put all pictures into a folder, use recordTableIndividual to generate a table and then create a .inp file by modifying the CamOperationMatrix to represent detections. This I did manually from recordTableIndividual. Its simple that way but I wish was able to code it as the data  also needs to be subsetted etc. which will be a pain to do manually.   

Regards,
Aditya.

Dear Aditya,
good to hear you found a solution to this problem. Unfortunately, I don't have the time to fully implement this feature at the moment and in the next few months.

But just a thought, if you create separate detection histories for each primary occasion, wouldn't it be possible to combine these with c() or rbind() and then recalculate the Freq column? If the encounter history is a charcter vector (something like c("10110", "00100", ...) , then table() should give the frequencies of each entry. These could then be combine, e.g. (assuming encounters is a vector of detection histories)

table_encounters <- table(encounters)

df_robust <- data.frame(ch   = names(table_encounters),
                        freq = table_encounters)
